name: Stylist
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve tall braided bun/band, hoops, dark patterned open robe, black shorts/belt, heeled boots, scissors, comb and chrome salon chair. Check stable clothing patterns, no blade contact with bodies, fabric shield continuity and readable full character/chair ending.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact adult brown-skinned stylist with a very tall sculpted braided bun held by a pale patterned band, large hoop earrings, dark slate patterned long open robe with pale trim, fitted black top and shorts, broad black belt, black lace-up heeled boots. Preserve her silver scissors, black comb and chrome salon chair with black upholstery. Do not change her own hairstyle or outfit.
0–0.7s: establish her whole body sitting cross-legged in the floating salon chair. She gives it one powerful heel-driven spin and snaps her scissors once. A plain wooden tailor's mannequin in a shabby gray coat floats beside her; she points the comb at it like a conductor.
0.7–2.5s: camera whips outward with the spinning chair as a huge silver-and-charcoal ribbon of fabric corkscrews thirty feet around the mannequin. Three precise scissor snaps cut the flowing ribbon into clean panels that immediately stitch together into a spectacular fitted armored longcoat on the mannequin. A gigantic iron sphere rushes in and hits the coat's flared shoulder; the fabric stiffens for one crisp contact hold, then rebounds it into far cyan with a huge bounded ivory/magenta impact star. Make the protective makeover a single spectacular action, not a fashion slideshow.
2.5–3.5s: snap camera back as her chair stops dead, robe tails still flaring. Exact title FRESH FIT slams below her face with a sharp scissor-and-metal impact. The completed mannequin turns a quarter-turn, its protective coat sparkling once at the seam.
3.5–5s: whole stylist, complete chair and fitted mannequin framed together against cyan. She spots one loose thread, clips it with a tiny precise snip, flicks it away with the comb and crosses her legs with a satisfied smirk. Chair casters and boots remain visible. SFX: hydraulic chair spin, fabric whip, three accelerating scissor SNAPS, zipper-like stitching rush, dominant armored impact/rebound, title slam and tiny final snip. No music, words or salon scenery.

params.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns. Use character-specific effects and props; do not add a recurring golden-fist emblem or generic fist-shaped power effect.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

name: Teacher Who Never Believed in Rappers
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve braided bun, gold glasses/chain/hoops, red pen, white blouse, brown vest, red tie, long dark skirt, satchel and red gradebook. Existing book/garment marks are fixed details; fresh loose pages have no captions. Review pen grip, microphone trap, exact question-mark title and sudden audio cutoff.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact stern adult brown-skinned teacher with braided updo, gold-rimmed glasses on a chain, large gold hoop earrings, white blouse, brown fitted vest, red tie, long dark pleated skirt, pale socks and black platform loafers. Preserve the red grading pen, red gradebook and overstuffed brown satchel. Existing garment and book-cover markings remain fixed source details; newly flying paper is blank.
0–0.7s: complete upright teacher looks over her glasses at a gigantic black stage microphone floating ahead, emitting three thick jagged crimson sound pulses. No performer, vocals or music, only obnoxious mechanical feedback. She uncaps the red pen with one sharp thumb movement.
0.7–2.5s: she draws one enormous red X in the air with two furious sweeping strokes. Camera rockets backward as blank pages erupt from her gradebook into a huge spiraling paper funnel. The red X snaps onto the microphone grille, stopping its pulse. The pages coil around the mic's body and drag it thirty feet backward into a colossal version of her open red gradebook, still connected to her original book by the continuous paper stream. Everything is a finite prop on cyan; no classroom, chalkboard or background rectangle.
2.5–3.5s: she slams her actual book shut. The colossal book simultaneously CLAPS shut around the microphone with a giant bounded ivory/crimson impact star, then shrinks neatly into the normal gradebook under her arm. Feedback cuts instantly to silence. Exact title STILL RAPPING? stamps across the lower composition with the question mark, face unobstructed. That sudden silence is the payoff.
3.5–5s: return to whole character. A tiny black microphone cord dangles from between the book's closed pages. She tucks it inside with one finger, caps the pen and slowly raises a deeply unimpressed eyebrow. Her long skirt and satchel settle. SFX: pen click, brief mechanical feedback whine, fast paper cyclone, two sharp pen slashes, dominant book CLAP with abrupt sound cutoff, title slam and tiny final pen click. No speech, lyrics, music or extra written grades.

name: The Asphalt Apostle
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve sepia/olive skin rendering, locs, muscular bare chest, ivory glyph-covered torn coat, black wide trousers/boots and dark staff. Do not expand source glyphs into new text or import image-edge artifacts. Review finite stone pieces with cyan gaps, no floor/environment, and continuous staff/guard action.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact muscular adult man with dark olive-brown skin rendered in the reference's dramatic sepia palette, thick short splayed locs, bare defined chest, long torn ivory coat covered in its original dark graphic glyphs, black belt, wide dark trousers, heavy dark boots and long dark staff. Preserve the reference markings as fixed fabric designs, never floating text. No new color makeover.
0–1.2s: low-angle full-body establishment, long coat sweeping behind him. He balances one small asphalt pebble on the tip of his horizontal staff, then flicks it upward. Three enormous jagged iron weights approach through cyan behind a small plain clay figurine at his side.
1.2–3.2s: he drives the staff tip into the airborne pebble. A colossal burst of individual asphalt slabs erupts outward from that single contact, suspended in cyan without any ground. Camera pulls far back as seven massive slabs rotate into a segmented protective shell around him and the clay figurine, like a giant open mechanical fan of stone. Leave broad cyan gaps between the slabs and keep his face visible through the front opening. The formation is a floating shield object, not a building or landscape.
3.2–4.8s: the three iron weights slam into the shell in an accelerating left-center-right sequence. Each stone slab shifts, absorbs the hit and grinds out a bounded ivory/ochre spark star. He plants the staff crosswise as a lever and twists his entire torso: the shell snaps OPEN with overwhelming force, launching all three weights away in diverging deep-perspective arcs. One monumental final stone-crack BOOM with disconnected dust chips, never a full-screen dust cloud. The clay figurine remains completely untouched.
4.8–6s: camera races back between the falling slabs to his focused face. Exact title CONCRETE CONGREGATION slams in two bold lines below his shoulders, warm ivory/gold and black like the series. The seven slabs spiral down into the one small pebble again.
6–8s: entire character and staff in a clear hero composition. He catches the pebble on his staff tip, gives the safely sheltered clay figurine a small approving nod, then brushes one speck of dust from his ivory coat. The pebble rolls once along the staff and stops at his hand. SFX: pebble tick, staff strike, enormous rising stone grind, three staggered heavy impacts, dominant shield recoil CRACK, receding weight whistles, title slam and small pebble clack. No speech, music, floor or architecture.

name: The Feds
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve one shadow-faced noir agent, black fedora/trench coat/suit/gloves, pale collar, burgundy tie and glossy shoes. No duplicate agents or inserted weapons. Review safe/clip scale, four-bar transfer, clear lock state, cyan outside objects and readable title.
choreography:
IDENTITY: ONE exact noir agent from the reference, adult man in a black fedora, long black trench coat, black three-piece suit, pale shirt collar, dark burgundy tie, black leather gloves and shiny black dress shoes. Face remains partly shaded by his hat as in the art, without making the cyan backing dark. Preserve his restrained expression and coat silhouette; do not add other agents or weapons.
0–1.2s: complete agent stands perfectly composed. He opens a small plain manila envelope with his left hand and removes one ordinary steel paperclip with his right. A massive charcoal safe floats far ahead on cyan, with four oversized gold bullion bars secured around its exterior. No lettering, serial numbers or currency portraits.
1.2–3.2s: he flicks the paperclip toward the safe. Camera races behind it and passes THROUGH its open center as the clip expands into a colossal steel loop, larger than a bus. It snaps around the safe in one crushing metallic clamp; the safe stays intact while the four exterior gold bars pop loose in four distinct beats. The open manila envelope in his distant left hand unfolds into a gigantic funnel mouth, still visibly connected to his hand.
3.2–4.8s: all FOUR bars accelerate into the envelope in a dramatic staggered procession, each passing close to camera before vanishing into its impossibly thin interior. He seals the envelope with one decisive thumb stroke. At that instant the huge paperclip around the emptied safe tightens into a locked steel band with an enormous bounded ivory/amber impact flash and one dominant CLACK. Seizure and lock are both visually clear; the base safe remains, stripped of its exterior bars.
4.8–6s: snap-zoom back to his shadowed face as he slips the now ordinary envelope inside his trench coat. Exact title ASSET SEIZURE slams below his collar with a stamp-like heavy impact. No official seals, new badges, legal text or extra captions.
6–8s: pull out to the full agent, the locked safe small and distant behind him. One last tiny gold bar falls late from above. Without moving his head he catches it between two fingers, pockets it, then tips his fedora by a fraction. Coat tails settle on pure cyan. SFX: dry envelope rustle, tiny paperclip ping, swelling metal flight, massive clamp CRUNCH, four rapid bullion clangs and whooshes, envelope slap, title stamp and tiny final coin-like clink. No dialogue, music or scenery.
